finding.claim: For negative numbers argument.toString(16/2/8) returns a string with a leading '-', so prefixing with '0x'/'0b'/'0o' yields '0x-A' / '0b-...' / '0o-...' instead of '-0xA' / '-0b...' / '-0o...', which is not valid JavaScript.
finding.title: Negative numbers with hexadecimal/binary/octal produce invalid literals

verifier.reason: The number branch at jsesc.js:216-225 unconditionally prefixes argument.toString(16/2/8) with '0x'/'0b'/'0o' with no sign handling, so a negative value such as -10 yields '0x-A'/'0b-1010'/'0o-12', which is invalid JavaScript.

repro.expectedBehavior: Negative numbers formatted as hexadecimal/binary/octal should place the minus sign before the prefix, e.g. -0xA, -0b101, -0o10, producing valid JavaScript literals.
